record.question: According to Margaret Mahler, predisposition to borderline personality disorder occurs when developmental tasks go unfulfilled in which of the following phases?
options: Autistic phase, during which the child's needs for security and comfort go unfulfilled
Symbiotic phase, during which the child fails to bond with the mother
Differentiation phase, during which the child fails to recognize a separateness between self and mother
Rapprochement phase, during which the mother withdraws emotional support in response to the child's increasing independence
